https://game-master.net/images/wiki/musicbox/musicbox1.png

The '''Music Box''' plays music in your home on voice command. It holds the shard's library of player compositions: free songs, songs you have bought, and your own. Composers publish their songs to it and are paid when players buy them.

__TOC__

==General Usage==
Buy a music box from any Bard NPC, lock it down in your home, and double-click it. It plays your whole playlist from start to finish, then stops. Double-click it again to stop it sooner.

Give your music box a name: single-click it and choose the rename option. You then speak to it by name, as you would to a smart speaker (its designer named his "Alexa"):

 Alexa, play Douce Dame Jolie
 Alexa, next
 Alexa, previous
 Alexa, repeat
 Alexa, shuffle
 Alexa, loop

You never need a song's whole name: a few words of it are enough, and the music box works out which song you mean, using Angel Island's Intelligent Dialogue System. ''Alexa, help'' lists every command.

To see what music is available, say ''list'':

 Alexa, list

https://game-master.net/images/wiki/musicbox/musicbox2.png

Yellow titles are yours to play: free songs, songs you have bought, and songs you composed. Red titles are premium songs, which cost gold.

To hear a premium song before buying it, ask the music box to play it:

 Alexa, play strut

https://game-master.net/images/wiki/musicbox/musicbox3.png

It plays a 10-second sample. To buy the song:

 Alexa, buy strut

The music box walks you through the purchase:

https://game-master.net/images/wiki/musicbox/musicbox4.png

When you agree, the price is taken from your bank (or your shared bank accounts) and paid into the composer's bank, here Pastor Wydstrin's. In this screenshot the player has named the music box ''Bach'', and asked for the song by part of its name.

https://game-master.net/images/wiki/musicbox/musicbox5.png

The song is now in your '''library''' and your '''playlist''', ready to play:
* Your library is every song you have access to.
* Your playlist is the songs from your library that the music box plays. You might take the Christmas songs out of it in July. ''Remove'' takes a song out; ''add'' puts it back.

https://game-master.net/images/wiki/musicbox/musicbox6.png

==List of Commands==
Say the music box's name, then the command. Several commands have a second word that does the same thing.

{| class="wikitable"
! Say !! What it does
|-
| play ''song'' || Plays a song from your library, or a 10-second sample of one you don't own.
|-
| stop (or cancel) || Stops playing.
|-
| pause || Pauses.
|-
| resume (or continue) || Resumes after a pause.
|-
| what (or who) || Says the song and its composer.
|-
| next, previous || The next or previous song in your playlist.
|-
| repeat || Plays the last song again.
|-
| loop || Plays your playlist over and over.
|-
| shuffle || Shuffles your playlist.
|-
| list || Lists the songs.
|-
| new || Lists recently approved songs.
|-
| buy ''song'' || Buys a premium song.
|-
| remove ''song'' (or ignore) || Takes a song out of your playlist.
|-
| add ''song'' || Puts a removed song back. ''add'' alone is the same as ''submit''.
|-
| refresh || Adds new free songs to your library. This also happens on its own.
|-
| purchases || The songs you have bought.
|-
| sales || Your sales as a composer (see [[#Getting Paid|Getting Paid]]).
|-
| submit (or add) || Publishes a song (see [[#Instructions for Composers|Instructions for Composers]]).
|-
| remaster || Asks to replace one of your approved songs with a new version.
|-
| rename || Renames the music box.
|-
| help || Lists the commands.
|}

==Instructions for Composers==
The Music Box is how composers share and sell their work across the shard.

# Write your song in a composition book and transcribe it into [[Sheet Music]]. Set its name and price at the top of the composition with # Song: and # Price: (a price of 0 makes it free). See [[Sheet Music#Settings|Settings]] for every setting.
# Single-click your music box and choose '''Add''', or say ''submit'' (or just ''add''). Target your sheet music.

https://game-master.net/images/wiki/musicbox/musicbox8.png

https://game-master.net/images/wiki/musicbox/musicbox9.png

Your song is now in the shard-wide library, not just your own music box, and goes into a review queue. Staff review songs to keep out offensive content, not to judge their quality (songs can have lyrics). While it waits, you can still play it on your own music box: it is in your playlist, and the box says it is pending approval. Once approved, it appears for every player: free songs in their libraries, premium songs as red titles they can sample and buy.

Each approved song earns you [[Music Composition#Music Karma|Music Karma]], and so does every sale and every play.

To publish a new version of an approved song, say ''remaster''.

The library is permanent and not tied to your account: once a song is in, it stays available to other players. If the character who composed a song is deleted, the song becomes free.

===Napster Tracks===
A song transcribed with ''# Napster: True'' is passed hand to hand instead of sold. Anyone who has a copy of its sheet music can add it to their own music box, which gives them the song (the sheet is used up). Other players hear only a sample, and are told to get a copy from the composer.

===Getting Paid===
When a player buys your song, the price goes straight into your bank. Say ''sales'' to see your totals:

 Alexa, sales

https://game-master.net/images/wiki/musicbox/musicbox10.png

If your bank box can't take the gold, the sale is recorded as a credit to you instead, shown in your sales. Credits record unpaid song sales but cannot currently be collected. They are not available as withdrawable gold. Each new sale is paid in gold whenever your bank box has room for it.

Say ''purchases'' to see the songs you have bought:

 Alexa, purchases

https://game-master.net/images/wiki/musicbox/musicbox11.png

==Leaderboard==
The Music Box records each composer's sales and the gold they have earned. The leaderboard at your local bank shows them.

https://game-master.net/images/wiki/musicbox/musicbox12.png

==Staff Reference==
Staff use these commands to run the library. Players can't use them.

{| class="wikitable"
! Say !! What it does !! Access
|-
| review || Lists the songs waiting for review. || Owner
|-
| approve ''song'' || Approves a song: it becomes available to every player. || Owner
|-
| deny ''song'' || Rejects a song. || Owner
|-
| delete ''song'' || Removes a song from the library. || Owner
|-
| find ''song'' || Shows a song's serial number, owner, and name. || Owner
|-
| dupe ''song'' || Puts a copy of a song's sheet music in your backpack. || Seer
|-
| flushall || Removes every song, everywhere. || Owner, Test Center only
|}
==History==
The Music Box was designed and built by Adam Ant in 2022, inspired by his Amazon Echo: hence "Alexa". See [[Music Composition#History and Credits|History and Credits]].
